title: The Role of Environmental Groups in Local Fracking Regulation
What Drives the Long-term Relationship between Economic Development and Environmental Quality? The Role of Spatial Dispersion vs. Agglomeration
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: The dramatic improvement in air quality in major Chinese cities in recent years has led to renewed interest in the question of whether economic development allows a country to “grow” out of its environmental problems. We shed new light on this question by identifying a new factor that can drive the long-term relationship between economic development and environmental quality , namely, a spatial effect that arises from a tradeoff between environmental quality and agglomeration economies . We show theoretically that this spatial effect can lead to an inverted U-shaped relationship between income and pollution, i.e., an environmental Kuznets curve . In addition, we decompose changes in US air pollution concentrations from 1990 to 2017 to allow for a possible spatial effect. Results point to the potential importance of a spatial effect in explaining the reductions in carbon monoxide (CO) concentrations. However, little of the change in sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) concentrations in the US can be attributed to a potential spatial effect.
abstract_zh: 近年来中国主要城市空气质量的显著改善，重新引发了人们对经济发展能否使一国“增长”出环境问题的兴趣。我们通过识别一个能够驱动经济发展与环境质量长期关系的新因素，为这一问题提供了新的见解，即由环境质量与集聚经济之间的权衡所产生的空间效应。我们从理论上表明，这种空间效应可能导致收入与污染之间呈倒U形关系，即环境库兹涅茨曲线。此外，我们分解了1990年至2017年美国空气污染浓度的变化，以考虑可能存在的空间效应。结果表明，空间效应可能在解释一氧化碳（CO）浓度的下降方面具有重要作用。然而，美国二氧化硫（SO2）浓度的变化中，很少能归因于潜在的空间效应。

title: Negative Traffic Externalities and Infant Health: The Role of Income Heterogeneity and Residential Sorting
Preemptive Incentives and Liability Rules for Wildfire Risk Management
abstract: Wildfires in the U.S. are growing in extent and severity, causing billions of dollars in damage each year. Wildfire policy has increased its focus on integrating fire suppression with risk mitigation through fuel reduction. In this context incentives to elicit management activities that mitigate fire risk are critical, because landowners may not carry out sufficient risk mitigation on their own. We examine the effectiveness and welfare implications of several incentive policies, including two novel approaches not studied in the context of wildfire management: liability rules and voluntary agreements. Our analysis uses a threshold model of public good provision, which allows for each landowner's mitigation choices to depend on the total amount of mitigation in the landscape. Our results suggest that the risk mitigation threshold is critical in determining the effectiveness and welfare effects of different incentive programs. When the threshold is high, only voluntary agreements and cost sharing can increase mitigation effort and welfare. Negligence standards can also be effective and welfare enhancing but only when the mitigation threshold is sufficiently low.
abstract_zh: 美国的野火范围日益扩大、严重程度日益加剧，每年造成数十亿美元的损失。野火政策日益关注将灭火与通过燃料削减来降低风险相结合。在这一背景下，激励土地所有者采取减缓火灾风险的管理活动至关重要，因为土地所有者自身可能不会进行充分的风险缓解。我们考察了若干激励政策的有效性及福利影响，其中包括两种在野火管理中尚未被研究过的新颖方法：责任规则和自愿协议。我们的分析采用公共物品供给的阈值模型，该模型允许每位土地所有者的缓解选择取决于整个景观中缓解的总量。我们的结果表明，风险缓解阈值对于决定不同激励计划的有效性及福利效应至关重要。当阈值较高时，只有自愿协议和成本分摊才能提高缓解努力和福利。过失标准在阈值足够低时，也可能有效且提高福利。

title: Willingness to Contribute as a Component of the Social Cost of Water Pollution
abstract: Individuals contribute significant sums to environmental organizations, such as water-related groups, whose goals are to preserve and improve local water quality. These groups also fundraise to support these goals. However, the social cost of water pollution lacks contributions to water groups and their fundraising expenditures. If contributions and fundraising respond to changes in local water quality, there is a willingness to contribute toward mitigation of water pollution. Social costs should count these values. We provide proof of concept for this argument, showing significant evidence of local water quality affecting contributions to environmental nonprofits, as well as fundraising expenditures. (JEL H41, Q53)
abstract_zh: 个人向环保组织捐献大量资金，例如水务相关团体，这些团体的目标是保护和改善当地水质。这些团体也会筹款以支持其目标。然而，水污染的社会成本并未计入对水务团体的捐款及其筹款支出。如果捐款和筹款会随当地水质变化而变化，那么就存在为缓解水污染而支付的意愿。社会成本应当计入这些价值。我们为这一论点提供了概念验证，显示出当地水质对环保非营利组织的捐款以及筹款支出具有显著影响的证据。（JEL H41, Q53）

title: Private Provision of Public Goods by Environmental Groups
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences
abstract: Many environmental nonprofit groups are assumed to provide public goods. While an extensive literature examines why donors join and give to nonprofits, none directly tests whether donations actually provide public goods. We seek such a test by using a common form of environmental organization: watershed groups. We find their increased presence resulted in lower dissolved oxygen deficiency and higher proportions of swimmable and fishable water bodies. Increased donations to and expenditures by the groups also improved water quality. Thus, private groups likely played a role in mitigating environmental problems. Overall, our results indicate private provision of a public good by nonprofit organizations.
abstract_zh: 许多环保非营利组织被认为提供公共物品。尽管已有大量文献考察捐赠者为何加入并向非营利组织捐款，但尚无研究直接检验捐款是否真正提供了公共物品。我们通过考察一种常见的环境组织形式——流域团体——来寻求这一检验。我们发现，这些团体的增加使溶解氧不足的情况减少，并使可供游泳和垂钓的水体比例上升。团体的捐款和支出增加也改善了水质。因此，私人团体很可能在缓解环境问题中发挥了作用。总体而言，我们的结果表明，非营利组织私人提供了公共物品。

title: Understanding the Scope and Limitations of Drought Management with Human-Natural System Models
The Economics of Species Conservation
abstract: A quarter of all species around the globe are threatened with extinction; this article reviews research in economics on how best to counter those threats. Normative research has developed useful tools for cost-effectively choosing areas of habitat to protect. Such work has also designed working-lands contracts that can induce efficient quantities and patterns of conservation on private lands. Positive research finds evidence that payments for ecosystem service programs are effective, but legal protections for threatened species have a mixed record of success. Economists have also measured both the nonmarket benefits and the costs of species conservation. Emerging work is tackling the particular challenges to species conservation posed by climate change, the demand for exploiting charismatic megafauna, and global population growth. Future research would do well to build on those three areas and to study distributional issues in the benefits and costs of species conservation.
abstract_zh: 全球约四分之一的物种面临灭绝威胁；本文综述了经济学领域关于如何最有效应对这些威胁的研究。规范性研究已发展出有用的工具，用于以成本效益方式选择需要保护的栖息地区域。此类工作还设计了农业用地合同，能够在私人土地上诱导出有效的保护数量和格局。实证研究发现，生态系统服务付费计划是有效的，但对濒危物种的法律保护成效参差不齐。经济学家还测算了物种保护的非市场效益和成本。新兴研究正在应对气候变化、对魅力大型动物（charismatic megafauna）开发利用的需求以及全球人口增长给物种保护带来的特殊挑战。未来研究最好能在这三个领域的基础上继续推进，并研究物种保护收益与成本的分配问题。

title: The Economics of the U.S. Endangered Species Act: A Review of Recent Developments
venue: Review of Environmental Economics and Policy

title: Finding Water Scarcity Amid Abundance Using Human-Natural System Models
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: How Does Urbanization Affect Water Withdrawals? Insights From an Econometric-Based Landscape Simulation
abstract: Effects on water resources are an understudied aspect of the environmental consequences of urbanization. We study how urban land development affects water withdrawals on a regional scale to account for market adjustments, human behavioral responses, and government institutions. Fine-scale econometric and simulation methods are used to represent the spatial heterogeneity associated with determinants of water withdrawals. Our analysis reveals a complicated relationship between future water withdrawals and changes in socioeconomic drivers. Despite population growth of approximately 85% and a doubling of income, water withdrawals in two urban areas increase by at most 12% and in another area, decrease slightly. (JEL Q24, Q25)
abstract_zh: 城市化对水资源的影响是环境后果中研究不足的一个方面。我们研究了城市土地开发如何在区域尺度上影响取水量，并同时考虑了市场调整、人类行为反应以及政府制度的作用。我们综合运用精细尺度的计量经济学方法与模拟方法，以刻画与取水量决定因素相关的空间异质性。我们的分析揭示了未来取水量与社会经济驱动因素变化之间的复杂关系。尽管人口增长约85%、收入翻了一番，两个城市地区的取水量最多仅增加12%，而另一地区的取水量则略有下降。（JEL Q24, Q25）

title: Impacts of Federal Crop Insurance on Land Use and Environmental Quality
abstract: This article integrates economic and biophysical models to assess how federal crop revenue insurance programs affect land use, cropping systems, and environmental quality in the U.S. Corn Belt region. The empirical framework includes econometric models that predict land conversion and crop choices at the parcel level based on expectation and variance of crop revenues, land quality, climate conditions, and physical characteristics at each site. The predictions are then combined with site‐specific environmental production functions to determine the effect of revenue insurance on nitrate runoff and leaching, soil water and wind erosion, and carbon sequestration. Results suggest that federal crop insurance has, on average, a small effect on conversions of non‐cropland to cropland, and somewhat more significant impacts on crop choice and crop rotation. These changes in cropping systems have, on average, small impacts on agricultural pollution.
abstract_zh: 本文整合了经济模型和生物物理模型，以评估联邦农作物收入保险计划如何影响美国玉米带地区的土地利用、种植制度和环境质量。实证框架包括计量经济模型，该模型基于作物收入的期望和方差、土地质量、气候条件以及每个地块的物理特征，在地块层面预测土地转换和作物选择。随后，这些预测与地块特定的环境生产函数相结合，以确定收入保险对硝酸盐径流与淋溶、土壤水蚀和风蚀以及碳封存的影响。结果表明，联邦农作物保险平均而言对非耕地向耕地的转换影响较小，但对作物选择和轮作的影响则较为显著。这些种植制度的变化平均而言对农业污染的影响较小。

title: Thresholds, Perverse Incentives, and Preemptive Conservation of Endangered Species
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: Implementation of the Endangered Species Act (ESA) on private land has historically focused on regulation after a species was officially listed. In recent years it has shifted toward offering pre-listing incentives to avoid listings and the costs and conflicts resulting from regulation. In this paper we take an initial step toward examining these pre-listing incentives. We allow the incentive structure, perverse incentives to destroy habitat or preemptive conservation, to be endogenously determined. We show that which incentive structure emerges depends on how high the conservation threshold is and on the relative costs of habitat conservation versus habitat destruction. It is critical to distinguish between these incentive structures because a policy that works in one setting does not necessarily work in the other. Our results shed light on policy decisions in several recent high-profile ESA cases.
abstract_zh: 濒危物种法（ESA）在私人土地上的实施，历来侧重于物种正式列为濒危之后的监管。近年来，其重点已转向提供列名前激励，以避免列名及其所带来的成本和冲突。在本文中，我们朝着考察这些列名前激励迈出了初步一步。我们允许激励结构（即破坏栖息地的恶性激励或事先保护的激励）内生决定。我们表明，出现哪种激励结构取决于保护阈值的高低，以及保护栖息地与破坏栖息地的相对成本。区分这两种激励结构至关重要，因为在一种环境中有效的政策，在另一种环境中未必有效。我们的结果为近期若干备受关注的ESA案件中的政策决定提供了启示。

title: Agricultural Landowners' Response to Incentives for Afforestation
Irrigation Decisions for Major West Coast Crops: Water Scarcity and Climatic Determinants
abstract: This article uses the 2007 Farm and Ranch Irrigation Survey database developed by the U.S. Department of Agriculture to assess the impact of water scarcity and climate on irrigation decisions for producers of specialty crops, wheat, and forage crops. We estimate an irrigation management model for major crops in the West Coast (California, Oregon, and Washington), which includes a farm‐level equation of irrigated share and crop‐specific equations of technology adoption and water application rate (orchard/vineyard, vegetable, wheat, alfalfa, hay, and pasture). We find that economic and physical water scarcity, climate, and extreme weather, such as frost, extreme heat, and drought, significantly impact producers’ irrigation decisions. Producers use sprinkler technologies or additional water applications to mitigate risk of crop damage from extreme weather. Water application rates are least responsive to surface water cost or groundwater well depth for producers of orchard/vineyard. Water supply institutions influence producers’ irrigation decisions. Producers who receive water from federal agencies use higher water application rates and are less likely to adopt water‐saving irrigation technologies for some crops. Institutional arrangements, including access to distinct water sources (surface or ground) and whether surface water cost is fee based, also affect the responsiveness of water application rates to changes in surface water cost. The analysis provides valuable information about how producers in irrigated agricultural production systems would respond and adapt to water pricing policies and climate change.
abstract_zh: 本文利用美国农业部开发的2007年农场与牧场灌溉调查数据库，评估水资源稀缺与气候对特种作物、小麦和饲草作物生产者灌溉决策的影响。我们针对西海岸（加利福尼亚州、俄勒冈州和华盛顿州）的主要作物建立了一个灌溉管理模型，其中包括一个农场层面的灌溉面积份额方程，以及针对各作物的技术采用和用水量方程（果园/葡萄园、蔬菜、小麦、苜蓿、干草和牧场）。我们发现，经济与物理意义上的水资源稀缺、气候以及霜冻、极端高温和干旱等极端天气，都显著影响生产者的灌溉决策。生产者使用喷灌技术或额外灌溉，以减轻极端天气造成作物损失的风险。对于果园/葡萄园生产者，用水量对地表水成本或地下井深度的反应最小。水供应制度影响生产者的灌溉决策。从联邦机构获得用水的生产者，对某些作物使用更高的用水量，且采用节水灌溉技术的可能性较低。制度安排，包括对不同水源（地表或地下）的获取，以及地表水成本是否以收费形式计收，也影响了用水量对地表水成本变化的反应程度。该分析为了解灌溉农业生产系统中的生产者将如何应对和适应水价政策及气候变化，提供了有价值的信息。

title: Incentives for Carbon Sequestration Using Forest Management
The Price and Welfare Effects of U.S. Biofuel Mandates and Subsidies
Voluntary Agreements and Private Enforcement of Environmental Regulation

title: Fuel Choice, Indoor Air Pollution, and Children's Health
abstract: Much of the population in developing countries uses firewood for cooking. The resulting indoor air pollution has severe health consequences for children who are close to the fire while their mothers cook. We use survey data from Guatemala to examine the effects of firewood consumption on the health of children up to five years of age. We also investigate the impact of cooking inside the home, the importance of a mother cooking while caring for her children and the role played by the smoke permeability of housing construction materials. We find that children living in households that use more wood, and where exposure to indoor air pollution is higher because the mother cooks while caring for children or because cooking takes place inside, are more likely to have symptoms of respiratory infection. Simulations indicate that policies that target cooking habits in order to directly reduce exposure, particularly by reducing the number of women who simultaneously cook and care for children, may be more effective for improving young children's health than policies to accelerate the adoption of gas stoves.
abstract_zh: 发展中国家的大部分人口使用木柴做饭。由此产生的室内空气污染，对在母亲做饭时待在火源附近的儿童造成严重的健康后果。我们利用危地马拉的调查数据，考察了木柴消费对五岁以下儿童健康的影响。我们还考察了在室内做饭的影响、母亲在照顾孩子的同时做饭的重要性，以及住房建筑材料的透烟性所起的作用。我们发现，使用更多木柴的家庭，以及因母亲边做饭边照顾孩子或因在室内做饭而暴露于更高室内空气污染水平的家庭，其儿童更可能出现呼吸道感染症状。模拟结果表明，针对烹饪习惯、旨在直接减少暴露的政策，尤其是减少同时做饭和照顾儿童的女性人数的政策，对改善幼儿健康可能比加快燃气灶普及的政策更为有效。

title: The Value of In-stream Water Temperature Forecasts for Fisheries Management
Potential Environmental Impacts of Increased Reliance on Corn-Based Bioenergy
Using In-stream Water Temperature Forecasts for Fisheries Management: An Application in the Pacific Northwest
venue: Journal of the American Water Resources Association

title: Allocating Conservation Resources under the Endangered Species Act
abstract: We explore the allocation of recovery funds to species listed under the Endangered Species Act. We simulate outcomes from allocations based on the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service's priority rankings and on rankings used in U.S. states' Wildlife Action Plans developed under the Congressional Wildlife Conservation and Restoration Program. We find that these criteria yield modest improvements over the FWS's current allocations and that documented inconsistencies in these allocations do not have a detrimental impact on the effectiveness of conservation spending. We also find that alternative policy goals—promoting recovery or preventing extinction—imply a tradeoff between increasing the number of Improving species and reducing the number of Extinct species of roughly 2:1.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了如何将恢复资金分配给依据《濒危物种法》列名的物种。我们模拟了基于美国鱼类和野生动物管理局（FWS）优先排序的分配结果，以及基于美国各州在国会《野生动物保护与恢复计划》下编制的《野生动物行动计划》所用排序的分配结果。我们发现，这些标准相比FWS目前的分配有适度改善，而且已有文献记载的这些分配中的不一致之处，并未对保护支出的有效性产生不利影响。我们还发现，不同的政策目标（促进恢复或防止灭绝）意味着在增加“改善”物种数量与减少“灭绝”物种数量之间存在约2:1的权衡。

title: Private Citizen Suits and Public Enforcement: Substitutes or Complements?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Predicting the Effect of Land Use Policies on Wildlife Habitat Abundance
Protecting Watershed Ecosystems through Targeted Local Land Use Policies
abstract: Land use change is the most pervasive force driving the degradation of watershed ecosystems. This article combines an econometric model of land use choice with models of watershed health indicators to examine the effects of land use policies on watershed ecosystems through their effect on land use. Our results suggest that incentive‐based land use policies and property acquisition programs can have relatively large positive impacts on watershed health, while policies that change the returns to land use are less effective. The results suggest that there is potential for targeting these policies because their impacts vary across watersheds with different land use mixes.
abstract_zh: 土地利用变化是导致流域生态系统退化的最普遍力量。本文将土地利用选择的计量模型与流域健康指标模型相结合，考察了土地利用政策通过影响土地利用而对流域生态系统产生的效应。我们的结果表明，基于激励的土地利用政策和财产收购计划，可以对流域健康产生相对较大的正面影响，而改变土地利用回报的政策则效果较差。结果表明，这些政策的目标定位具有潜力，因为其影响在具有不同土地利用构成的流域之间存在差异。

title: Self Reporting and Private Enforcement in Environmental Regulation
Learning from Endangered and Threatened Species Recovery Programs: A Case Study Using U.S. Endangered Species Act Recovery Scores
Pollution Abatement with Limited Enforcement Power and Citizen Suits
Conservation of Endangered Species: Can Incentives Work for Private Landowners?
Startup Costs and the Decision to Switch from Firewood to Gas Fuel
abstract: Firewood remains a key source of energy for households in developing countries, contributing to forest degradation and deforestation. The adoption of alternative fuels may be hindered by high startup costs, and this problem may be compounded by restrictions in credit availability. We use survey data to examine how credit access affects firewood consumption in Guatemala. Our results suggest that access to credit plays a statistically significant role in determining firewood consumption through its effect on the ability to purchase a gas stove. However, simulations suggest that these effects are small and that subsidizing stoves would be a more promising policy for reducing firewood consumption. (JEL O13, Q23, Q48)
abstract_zh: 木柴仍然是发展中国家家庭的一项关键能源来源，并导致森林退化和砍伐。替代燃料的采用可能受到高昂启动成本的阻碍，而信贷可得性的限制可能使这一问题更加严重。我们利用调查数据，考察了信贷可得性如何影响危地马拉的木柴消费。我们的结果表明，信贷可得性通过影响购买燃气灶的能力，在决定木柴消费方面发挥着统计上显著的作用。然而，模拟结果表明，这些效应较小，补贴炉灶将是减少木柴消费更有前景的政策。（JEL O13, Q23, Q48）

title: Conservation Incentives Programs for Endangered Species: An Analysis of Landowner Participation
abstract: It has been argued that the land-use restrictions prescribed by the Endangered Species Act have failed to protect endangered species on private land. Hence, there has been a call for using incentives to complement this regulatory approach. This paper uses data from a survey of private forest owners to examine the demographic and land characteristics that determine landowner participation in incentives programs. The results suggest that targeting incentives to younger landowners who have acquired property more recently, who own more woodland, and who are interested in conservation and providing wildlife habitat may be effective in increasing participation rates.
abstract_zh: 有观点认为，《濒危物种法》规定的土地利用限制未能保护私人土地上的濒危物种。因此，人们呼吁使用激励措施来补充这一监管方式。本文利用一项针对私有林地所有者的调查数据，考察了决定土地所有者参与激励计划的人口特征和土地特征。结果表明，将激励措施瞄准较年轻的土地所有者（他们近期购入财产、拥有更多林地，并对保护及提供野生动物栖息地感兴趣），可能有效提高参与率。

title: Voluntary Conservation of Endangered Species: When Does No Regulatory Assurances Mean No Conservation?
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
